name: Gun Probe (research)
description: Research for Exusiai's summoned guns: can a HUD addon spawn one of the game's own gun models as a visual only and keep it hovering beside the view? F6 spawns two for 10 s, each playing the Guard Dog's firing sound; Shift+F6 logs what the engine lets the addon reach. Bring a Guard Dog (AR-23) or a machine gun so a gun model is loaded. Needs Bingus Shared Loader and HD2Runtime. Turn off when done.
